response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile individual-contributor engineer with deep technical breadth (web, mobile, embedded, DLang tooling) and some workshop/teaching experience, but the resume shows no evidence of formal people management, team leadership, performance reviews, or roadmap ownership — all core, heavily-weighted requirements for this management role. His career trajectory has remained IC/Staff/Senior Developer throughout, with no direct reports or organizational change leadership mentioned, making him a poor fit for a people-leadership position despite strong developer-tools experience.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools, test runners, and CI/CD infrastructure (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, GitLab/CI setup)
Broad technical range across languages and platforms (web, mobile, embedded, systems programming)
Demonstrated ability to teach and mentor via workshops, talks, and Refactoring Dojos
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct-report responsibility anywhere in 15+ years of experience
No mention of conducting one-on-ones, performance expectations, or leading organizational change
Career has stayed at IC/Staff/Senior Developer level rather than progressing into management or team-lead roles

key_factors.factor: No demonstrated roadmap/strategic leadership or org-change experience
Strong developer-tools and testing infrastructure background
